name: dup3
synopsis: int dup3(int oldfd, int newfd, int flags);
description: dup3() duplicates a file descriptor, similar to dup2(), but allows specifying flags to set the close-on-exec flag. It fails if the old and new file descriptors are the same or if invalid flags are provided.

parameters.name: newfd
parameters.description: The new file descriptor number to use

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags for the operation, such as O_CLOEXEC to set close-on-exec

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: oldfd isn’t an open file descriptor
newfd is out of the allowed range for file descriptors
This may be returned during a race condition with open(2)
The call was interrupted by a signal
The per-process limit on open file descriptors has been reached
